title: One deletion from a palindrome
prompt:
Return true if text reads the same forwards and backwards after deleting at most one character.

- text has 0 to 100,000 lowercase English letters.
- The empty string and single characters are palindromes.
hints: Compare characters from both ends while they match. What does the first mismatch tell you?
At the first mismatch (i, j), one of the two characters must be the deleted one.
Check whether text[i+1..j] or text[i..j-1] is a palindrome; no other deletion can help.

solution.explanation: Matching outer characters never need deleting, so skip them. At the first mismatch the deletion must remove one of the two mismatched characters; try both and check the remaining middle with a plain palindrome scan.

complexity.notes: At most three linear scans. Trying every deletion is O(n²).

followUps: Generalise to at most k deletions. Which technique replaces the two-pointer scan?
